utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Good afternoon to everyone in and around the courtroom. I hope everybody has had a well-deserved rest and we're all ready to work and work very hard. Mr. Registrar, will you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honours. Good afternoon to everyone in and around the courtroom. This is case number IT-04-81-T, the Prosecutor versus Momcilo Perisic. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much. Could we have appearances for the day starting with the Prosecution, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. HARMON
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honours, counsel, everyone in the courtroom. Mark Harmon, Salvatore Cannata and Inger de Ru on behalf of the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much. And for the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honours. Good afternoon to everyone taking part this these proceedings in and out of the courtroom. Milos Androvic, Daniela Tasic, Tina Drolec, Gregor Guy-Smith, and Novak Lukic appear today as Defence team for General Perisic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Lukic. We are in open session. The witness is a protected witness. May we please move into closed session. And may the witness then be called in.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, we're in open session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Then the matter stands adjourned to tomorrow morning, 9.00 in Courtroom II. Court adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Friday, the 21st day of August, 2009, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 7.00 p.m.,
